answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in a separate escrow, but equivocation evidence links coordinated signatures. For k correlated identities, the penalty schedule grows as O(k^2), so shared control cannot be cheaply fragmented across sybils. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, accelerating asymmetric depreciation and deterring recidivism. A prism of evidence leaves no haven for a sonnet of colluding claims.
